005package org.wpilib.command3;
006
007import java.util.Collection;
008import java.util.function.Consumer;
009import org.wpilib.annotation.NoDiscard;
010
011/**
012 * A stage in a command builder where requirements have already been specified and execution details
013 * are required. The next stage is a {@link NeedsNameBuilderStage} from {@link
014 * #executing(Consumer)}. Additional requirements may still be added before moving on to the next
015 * stage.
016 *
017 * <p>This class is provided by the Commands v3 VendorDep
018 */
019@NoDiscard
020public interface NeedsExecutionBuilderStage {
021  /**
022   * Adds a required mechanism for the command.
023   *
024   * @param requirement A required mechanism. Cannot be null.
025   * @return This builder object, for chaining
026   * @throws NullPointerException If {@code requirement} is null
027   */
028  NeedsExecutionBuilderStage requiring(Mechanism requirement);
029
030  /**
031   * Adds one or more required mechanisms for the command.
032   *
033   * @param requirement A required mechanism. Cannot be null.
034   * @param extra Any extra required mechanisms. May be empty, but cannot contain null values.
035   * @return This builder object, for chaining
036   * @throws NullPointerException If {@code requirement} is null or {@code extra} contains a null
037   *     value
038   */
039  NeedsExecutionBuilderStage requiring(Mechanism requirement, Mechanism... extra);
040
041  /**
042   * Adds required mechanisms for the command.
043   *
044   * @param requirements Any required mechanisms. May be empty, but cannot contain null values.
045   * @return This builder object, for chaining
046   * @throws NullPointerException If {@code requirements} is null or contains a null value.
047   */
048  NeedsExecutionBuilderStage requiring(Collection<Mechanism> requirements);
049
050  /**
051   * Sets the function body of the executing command.
052   *
053   * @param impl The command's body. Cannot be null.
054   * @return A builder for the next stage of command construction.
055   * @throws NullPointerException If {@code impl} is null.
056   */
057  NeedsNameBuilderStage executing(Consumer<Coroutine> impl);
058}
